name: University of Strathclyde
description:
The University of Strathclyde is a leading university located in the bustling metropolis of Glasgow. Voted University of the Year 2019 in the Times Higher Education Awards, they're a 5-star QS-rated university (2017-20) and students benefit from exceptional teaching, innovative approaches and excellent facilities.

\n\n

The university also has 19 subjects in the Top 10 Times rankings this year, including Accounting and Finance, Social Policy, Pharmacology and Pharmacy, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Economics and Business Studies.

Glasgow is a diverse and welcoming city where students have excellent work experience opportunities to compliment their studies as well as build a broad and interesting co-curricular and social life. Home to over 23,000 students from over 100 countries, the university truly is international and students are part of a warm and inviting community.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: When you choose the University of Strathclyde, you're joining a leading international university that’s popular for its innovation and research, especially in engineering, science, and business. Nearly 90% of its research was rated as ‘world-leading’ or ‘internationally excellent’ by the Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2021.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
With a diverse community of over 30,000 students from more than 140 countries, you'll be meeting students from all over the world. Plus, with over 200 clubs and societies, you'll have ample opportunities to engage in activities that interest you. Not just that, you’ll also find a games area with pool tables, a bar and bistro, a coffee shop, and more such facilities.

The Disability & Wellbeing Service at the university offers many support services to help you. These include one-to-one mental health and wellbeing assessments, counselling services, group therapies, and peer support.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Strathclyde provides various accommodation options, located within Glasgow's city centre. You can choose from standard or en-suite rooms, with laundry facilities and security. The StrathUnion's Advice Hub can assist you in finding suitable family accommodation options if needed.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Andersonian Library is the primary library at the University of Strathclyde. You’ll be surprised to know that this is one of the largest academic libraries in Scotland, where you get over 1 million print volumes, more than 400,000 electronic books, and access to over 37,000 e-journals. At the library, you can also explore "The Nook," a wellbeing space where you can play puzzles, board games, and enjoy a cosy atmosphere for relaxation. ​

Sports
Strathclyde Sport is the university's GBP 31 million sports and wellbeing facility. Here, you get state-of-the-art sports amenities, including a 25-metre six-lane swimming pool, a fitness suite, two squash courts, a dance studio and many such facilities.

Laboratory
As a student at Strathclyde, you’ll have access to several specialised laboratories across various disciplines. Some of these include the Sustainable Labs, the Advanced Materials Research lab, StrathLab, and more.

Cafeteria
You can find several cafes and eateries on campus, operated by Nourish. Some spots where you can refuel yourself are Aura, Flava in the Andersonian Library, Grab and Go, the Sports Cafe, and Social Bite at Todd's.
